ruleDefinitions.name: RemCom Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects RemCom service installation and execution events Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ServiceName = "RemComSvc" OR ImagePath = RGX("\\\\RemComSvc\\\.exe$")))
